The '''Xan''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to [[Algara II]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Xan-AE.png|thumb|left|111px|A Xan]]
The Xan were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to [[Algara II]]. They had a lifespan of 80 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]], and sported dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a long body beneath a large, bulbous head, with skin [[Color/Legends|colored]] green, yellow, or pink. Five slender fingers protruded from the ends of their arms.<ref name="AE" />

They could not tolerate temperatures below zero degrees [[Standard (temperature)|Standard]]. If temperatures were to have fallen below zero yet above minus ten degrees Standard, a Xan would have fallen into a deep sleep; temperatures below this was [[Death/Legends|lethal]] to Xan.<ref name="AE" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CentralMarketXan.jpg|thumb|right|85px|A Xan-like alien in ''Republic 79'']]
The Xan species was first mentioned and depicted in the [[1992]] book ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'', which was written by [[John Terra]].<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]''</ref> The [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]] pictures an alien similar in appearance to a Xan, although the figure's species is not identified.<ref name="Republic 79">[[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]]</ref>
